svg.textArea: Outbound, end to end. Draft design from context/docs/gtm-system.md. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 2 Pick the people and write the message

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, signal matrix, approved facts, workflow spec

1B Buying signals
• Hiring HR or payroll staff
• Frontline hiring 3+ posts
• Hiring in a 2nd country
• Firms selling payroll
• New HR or finance leader

1C Find companies
Clean domain, one row per company, deduped

1E Enrich
Headcount, industry, HQ, states, funding, ERP
Drop, or hold if KE, GH, ZA

2A Pick the angle
First matching signal wins: 2nd country, manual payroll, new leader, multi-state

2B Find people
Champion first, then economic buyer. Max 2 per account

2C Find and verify email
Waterfall, own keys first

2F Write copy and QA
Approved facts only, then campaign-qa

3A Send the sequence
• Email: 3 to 4 steps over 14 days
• LinkedIn: request, 2 DMs, rep tasks

3B Sort replies
AI tags the intent, other channel paused
Wait for a new signal, back to 1B

3G Weekly review
Results by signal, segment, angle. Learnings note, Context OS edits
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
